documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting 30Th October 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust demand in the commercial vehicle, trailer, and tractor segments, alongside an increase in export contributions. Management highlighted that capacity expansions and backward integration initiatives, including the seamless tube facility and extruded axle beams, are progressing well and expected to improve utilization and margins over the coming quarters. While rising consumable and commodity costs have put pressure on margins, price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to provide support in Q3 and Q4. The company remains focused on operational efficiency, cost discipline, and strategic growth across its business segments. Kross Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV, trailer, and tractor segments, alongside contributions from new capacity expansions.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports this year to be 45% higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2, noting that historically H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Management expects Kross to deliver healthy growth in FY27 supported by healthy order books, sustained demand, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion.
guidance.quote: With healthy order books, sustained demand in the trailer and tractor segments, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion, Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects a growth of 40% to 45% in its exports for the financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management plans to achieve an export contribution of around 8% in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent.

demand_outlook.claim: We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The continued momentum in commercial vehicles, healthy tractor demand and the planned ramp-up for our new products provide good opportunities of growth for us.
demand_outlook.quote: The continued momentum in commercial vehicles, healthy tractor demand and the planned ramp-up for our new products provide good opportunities of growth for us.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum in the M&HCV segment continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment volumes in Q2 exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the tractor and agri segment remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The M&HCV segment momentum from Q4 FY26 continued into Q1 FY27 despite slightly subdued monsoon demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the M&HCV segment, the momentum in the CV segment from Q4 FY26 continued into Q1 FY27. The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

demand_outlook.claim: OEMs have indicated strong demand for September Q2 and subsequently Q3 and Q4.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor industry data for April 2026 remained encouraging with consistent demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the Tractor segment, demand has been consistent, on track to increase contribution meaningfully over the coming years. April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging and we remain on track to meaningfully increase the contribution of tractor segment sales to our revenues.

capex_expansion.claim: Our seamless tube facility is progressing as per schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Our seamless tube facility is progressing as per schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are targeted for February-March 2027, with the facility involving an investment of approximately Rs. 167 Crores and a proposed capacity addition of 120,000 tons.
The installed capacity for tipping jacks is 800 kits per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle beam extrusion line has started production.
capex_expansion.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, doubling foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers were concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Extruded technology adoption is expected to drive market share gains, improve profitability, and open new export revenue streams.
margins_costs.quote: This Extruded Technology adoption is expected to drive market share gains, improve profitability, and open new export revenue streams

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration through the seamless tube facility enhances backward integration, reduces external dependency, and lowers production costs.
margins_costs.quote: Enhances backward integration, reduces external dependency, and lowers production costs.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year with margins expanding to 12.23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

margins_costs.claim: A recent steel price settlement retrospective to all suppliers occurred around July 15th.
margins_costs.quote: One is with the commodity price increase, that is steel for us. So steel, there has been a very recent settlement which has been given retrospective to all the suppliers. This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

orders_capacity.claim: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Axles and suspension volumes increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 226 tipping jacks in Q1 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Total axle volume in Q1 was almost 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes were around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The seamless tube facility is funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Funded through a mix of debt & internal accruals

capital_allocation.claim: IPO fund utilization has been fully completed as per the plan.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan.

risks_headwinds.quote: The risks and uncertainties relating to these statements include, but are not limited to, risks and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, our ability to manage growth, competition (both domestic and international), economic growth in India and abroad, ability to attract and retain highly skilled professionals, time and cost over runs on contracts, our ability to manage government policies and actions regulations, interest and other fiscal costs generally prevailing in the economy.

risks_headwinds.claim: June and July are periods where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.
